name: syncboard-ai
description: SyncBoard AI+ — an intelligent real-time collaborative web platform for distributed teams.

scripts.dev:clean: for port in 3000 4000; do lsof -ti tcp:$port | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; done && rm -rf apps/web/.next && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/bootstrap-env.mjs && npm run db:setup && npm run db:seed
